chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 411: Ji Ning Defends His Master Against Blood God Sect Ambush
chapter_meta_description: During Diancai Immortal’s Heart Demon Tribulation, the Blood God Sect arrives with eight experts. Ji Ning’s Primaltwin reveals nine top-grade immortal swords.
og_title: Ji Ning vs. The Blood God Sect – A Mid-Tribulation Siege
og_description: The Blood God Sovereign and his Seven Dharma Kings ambush Diancai Immortal mid-tribulation. Ji Ning counter-attacks with a hidden nine-sword formation.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 411 – Diancai Immortal Under Attack!
twitter_description: The Blood God Sect launches a tribulation raid. Ji Ning drops a nine-sword bomb that shatters their combined blood dragon.

lore_anchors.definition: The third and final tribulation before achieving Celestial Immortal. The cultivator is fully immersed in a world of inner demons and has no awareness or defense against the outside world.
A technique that allows multiple cultivators to merge their power into a single entity, greatly boosting their combat capabilities.
The Seven Dharma Kings’ signature formation; they combine their auras into a thousand-zhang blood dragon.
A second body cultivated by a Ki Refiner at the Primal Daoist stage; it shares the same soul and consciousness.
The highest grade of immortal-ranked treasures; extremely rare and powerful.
